name: Fish Detection
description: For ocean environment protection, the government invested substantial time and effort in environmental protection, such as funding environment research and introducing new laws and regulations. Nowadays, artificial intelligence is considered an exact method because it may bring reforms to this area. Also, AI has acquired significant achievements, such as computer vision and deep learning fields. However, there are few publicly available, large scale underwater benchmark datasets.
